latest_release.name: DroidDeck 0.7.1
latest_release.body: **DroidDeck is 100% open source. No ads. No telemetry. No proprietary components. No source withheld.** 0.7.1 is a fix release for 0.7.0. Since 0.7.0, **4 people** sent **33 pull requests**, and **2 of them are first-time contributors**. It fixes Steam launches that hung at "Processing install script", the endless loading screen after quitting a game and colour on PowerVR, plus GOG DLC and a new launcher theme. ### Features - Added the **Scarlet snow** launcher theme, DroidDeck’s first light theme. (@EnzoDLofi, [#2262](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2262)) - Added **left and right picture alignment** next to top and bottom. The controller pointer and direct touch follow the moved picture, also with glasses. (@EnzoDLofi, [#2384](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2384)) - **GOG installs the DLC you own**, and the GOG search reaches GOG’s whole catalog. (@maxjivi05, [#2348](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2348), [#2296](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2296)) ### Fixed - Fixed **Steam games stuck at “Processing install script”** or a download that never finishes, and the black screen with “Abort game” after quitting, which started in 0.7.0. (@xXJSONDeruloXx, [#2303](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2303)) - Fixed **a game launched from DroidDeck stalling at Steam’s launch screen**: DroidDeck now waits for Steam to be ready. (@maxjivi05, [#2362](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2362)) - Fixed **an endless loading screen** after a game exits back to Steam. (@maxjivi05, [#2359](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2359)) - The bottom-screen Dashboard’s **Notifications page is removed**, so DroidDeck no longer asks to read your notifications. (@xXJSONDeruloXx, [#2342](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2342)) - Fixed **grayscale Steam and games on PowerVR** (Pixel 10 Pro and Pro XL) since the Ubuntu 26.04 runtime. (@maxjivi05, [#2287](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2287)) - Fixed **games that need EasyAntiCheat** never starting: Linux-only tools such as the Proton EasyAntiCheat Runtime keep their native platform. (@maxjivi05, [#2313](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2313)) - Fixed **a Proton picked in Steam**, such as Proton Experimental, being switched back to DroidDeck-Proton, and **store apps launched before Steam opens** reporting that no Proton is installed. (@maxjivi05, [#2284](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2284), [#2392](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2392)) - Fixed **games failing with `c000007b`** after an installer put an x64 system DLL into an ARM64 prefix. (@maxjivi05, [#2318](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2318)) - Fixed **emulators and other AppImage, Flatpak and Snap programs** rendering through system memory on Adreno. They get the game GPU setting, and Flatpak apps open their window instead of playing audio only. (@maxjivi05, [#2288](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2288), [#2295](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2295), [#2391](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2391)) - Fixed **Linux emulators that run guest code natively** hanging on launch. (@maxjivi05, [#2279](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2279)) - Fixed **Firefox tabs crashing** and the **desktop browser hanging** in the Desktop session.
